name: Richard "Ritchie" Cajulis
office: City of Walnut, Member of the City Council

items.text: Richard “Ritchie” Cajulis is a member of the Walnut City Council. He was appointed to the council in 2022. He has a background in engineering and IT and works as an IT analyst at a law firm. Before joining the council, he served on the city’s Parks and Recreation Commission.

sentences.text: Richard “Ritchie” Cajulis is a member of the Walnut City Council.
He was appointed to the council in 2022.
He has a background in engineering and IT and works as an IT analyst at a law firm.
Before joining the council, he served on the city’s Parks and Recreation Commission.

items.text: On the council, he voted to certify the environmental review for the Brookside housing project and approve a 27-home tract map in January 2026. He voted to approve a 42-unit residential project on Valley Boulevard in February 2026. He voted to introduce an ordinance regulating electric bicycles and scooters in March 2026. His campaign says he has worked with the Sheriff’s Department to reduce crime and has proposed more programs for families and seniors.
